answer.headline: Orders remained within normal variation overall, but a shift toward new visitors affected the metric negatively starting mid-week.
explanation: Overall orders increased while staying within normal weekly variation limits {F5} and following the post-Cyber Monday period {F2}.
The primary candidate cause is a mix shift toward new users {F23}, which grew much faster than returning visitors {F26}.
New users experienced a lower conversion rate compared to the rest of the site {F29}, pulling down overall performance.
answer.next_step: Investigate acquisition campaigns and landing page experiences tailored to new visitors to improve their conversion rate.
